mutations.name: one legacy flag form dropped (single-dash -model stops being accepted)
the-desk Opus refusal removed from the domain check (nothing below the adapter refuses; a parser-bypassing caller is admitted)
--set stops persisting (the cell.env write after a launch's overrides is dropped)
scratch run loses its command boundary (the OpaqueArgv declaration dropped): a word of the supervised command that spells --source, --task or --help is parsed by cellctl
the adapter stops inserting the opaque-argv boundary (splitOpaqueArgv no longer called by Run)
the hidden completion entrypoints answer again (the refusal command is not registered)
the single-dash selector before a raw verb is no longer respelled, so Cobra reads its value as the verb
the hook watchdog and raw-verb detection see only the separated double-dash selector (the = and single-dash spellings hide the verb)
